newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cricket-Bangladesh win toss, put S.Lanka to bat.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Bangladesh win toss, put S.Lanka to bat.

text.p: Bangladesh won the toss and sent Sri Lanka in to bat in their Asia Cup match at Colombo's Singhalese Sports Club ground on Tuesday.
The match has been reduced to 46 overs a side after overnight rains delayed the start by an hour. Monday's match between India and Pakistan was abandoned due to rain.

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Mavan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Lanka de Silva, Upul Chandana, Ruwan Kalpage, Dulip Liyanage, Mutthiah Muralitharan, Sajeewa de Silva.
Bangladesh: Akram Khan (captain), Athar Ali Khan, Naimur Rahman, Habeebul Bashar, Aminul Islam, Mafizur Rahman, Khalid Masud, Hasidul Hossain, Saiful Islam, Shaikh Salahuddin, Minhajul Abdin.
